notes: Preconditions that are broken today. Each gate names one root cause and the error signature that identifies it in a run. Failures matching a signature are reported as blocked, so one defect does not read as dozens of independent coverage regressions. Remove a gate once its defect is fixed and the signature stops matching — DEF-7 and DEF-8 were deleted on 2026-09-08 for exactly that reason.

gates.title: Analyze Data crashes before it requests a report
gates.meaning: The mastered tiles never leave `--`, so every check that waits for a figure times out. This is the whole Analyze Data UI lane: the summary tiles, the skill-area chart, the grouping and date-window controls, the mode tabs, the mastery review list and the page's axe scan. The Analyze Data API checks are unaffected and still pass.
gates.rootCause: Frontend null dereference, not an API failure. Loading the page issues 177 calls that all return 200, then throws `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'trim')` 70 times and never requests analyze-data at all. The configured client carries the nulls that trigger it — of 86 programs, `area` is null on 15, `goalDescription` on 15 and `category` on 11; of 25 series, `skillArea` is null on 13. The mastered report groups by Domain, Category or Area, so a null grouping key is the likeliest trigger.
gates.signature: in-scope tile should resolve to a number|mastered-tile-in-scope

gates.title: Behavior plans cannot be listed
gates.meaning: Behavior Support cannot show a client's plans. The scenarios that assert the correct behaviour are tagged @bug and excluded from the default run, so this gate is usually invisible there.
gates.rootCause: HTTP 500 for every client on dev2.
